title: 末班航司交替与全天航司搭配联合软优化

expectation.example: Owner要求末班AK/TR尽量跨工作班交替，并纠正仅交换晚班的错误理解：上一班TR，本班FD+AK时可改上午为CX+AK；只有FD上午可排时允许原搭配偏好为末班交替让步。不限具体姓名或CX模板。
expectation.expected: 先同时改善末班连续同航司和全天组合，候选覆盖全天可移动岗位；原上午可换任意合法组外航司。无法兼顾时优先改善末班交替，允许仅为此必要的组合让步，不转移连续重复给他人。末班范围沿已配置末班航班及结束界线，基于上一份完整已归档工作班实际人员/航司；新增可迁移开关默认启用，关闭保持旧搭配行为。
expectation.unchanged: 岗位完整、资质、状态、夜班、时间、半休、工时、值班/人工锁定、重点次数轮换、月度休息继续优先。为实际CX/FD早晚不等时段可轮换，联合模式允许已有长短日/割裂日轮换，但全队跨度/空挡排序及合计、割裂人数不退步；关闭或无可比末班保留原逐人保护。有限搜索无结果保留原合法表。A/B隔离，历史不改写，换季已提交和验收状态不变。命中G01/G03/G04/G05/G06、R01/R03、D01/D02、V02/V04。
expectation.fallback: 只在独立目录实施；原工作区逐项指纹核对再合回，冲突停止覆盖。不存在双满足方案或有限预算不足时说明让步或保留原因，不清空岗位，不把软偏好变成拒绝整表的硬约束。不自动commit/push/部署，不操作真实浏览器或云库。

answers.originalFailure: Three tests first caught missing historic carrier alternation; three realistic unequal-time tests then caught old comfort checks freezing existing long/short days. Same cases now pass.
answers.laterChanges: Final mix phase cannot reverse alternation or transfer repeat to another person; shared continuity comparator checks team spans/gaps/splits, original safety and priority checks remain; manual edits reflected in final feedback.
answers.finalArtifact: Worker-produced XLSX and JSON independently match peer-a CX102/AK103 and peer-b FD101/TR104 at original unequal periods, four rows and zero vacancies, with safe snapshots and final credential. Real-page acceptance pending.

review.missedScope: No private real-day solve or real browser acceptance. Missing/partial prior archive and persons absent on previous workday do not invent older late history. Finite search and five-person cap are explicitly best effort. Shared worktree integration is conflict checked.
review.rootCause: Previous preference only measured same-day airline combinations. A late-only trade-off was initially assumed, and equal-time tests hid personal-span/split protections freezing existing shifts. Whole-day optimization and guarded burden redistribution address the real example.
review.earlyDetection: Before implementation derive expected whole-day outcomes from original varied flight times, not equal-time fixtures. Test both an already alternating late assignment and repeated late assignments; then verify only-FD fallback, three-person cycles, migration effects and actual Worker/XLSX output.
